title: The Flower Picked without Asking
youtube_title: The Flower Picked without Asking | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Femi is tangled up with a flower picked from a pot that was not yours and almost hides it. Femi tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
